limitations: No new PostgreSQL test, production read or activation executed by this reviewer. Producer owns focused actual-PG tests.
500 IDs bound cardinality and helper invocations, not wall time or total helper work; actual exact-page plan/performance qualification remains required.
A completed scan is not a complete plan or proof of acquisition. The final aggregate and sealer runtime remain unmeasured.
Catalog facts are point-in-time; root must reconcile current owner, source/key/trigger guards and uncertain operations before activation.
The observed replication mode belongs to the diagnostic session; no universal historical or future privileged-writer guarantee is asserted.
New missing work behind/above the cursor must fail the unchanged final sealer; it does not authorize automatic cursor reset.
